sample_unit: post-allo-HSCT patients (666 early warning; 805 diagnostic, 1574 eyes)

links.outcome: Performance in external validation, reported by site, for early warning and diagnosis
links.effect: Early warning AUROC was 83.45% externally (93.44% internally); diagnostic AUROCs at three external sites were all above 96.0%.
links.quote: In external validation, the early warning AUROC was 83.45%, while diagnostic AUROCs across three external sites were all above 96.0%.

links.outcome: Disease severity at presentation among patients after using the early warning model
links.effect: Disease severity of patients seeking medical treatment after using the early warning model was significantly lower (no numbers in abstract).
links.quote: The disease severity of patients seeking medical treatment after using the early warning model was significantly lower.

links.outcome: Junior ophthalmologists' diagnostic accuracy with versus without model assistance
links.effect: Junior ophthalmologists improved diagnostic accuracy when using the model as an auxiliary tool (no numbers in abstract).
links.quote: Junior ophthalmologists also improved diagnostic accuracy using the model as an auxiliary tool.

screen.reason: The study develops a multimodal LLM for chronic ocular GVHD and evaluates its clinical utility by testing clinician diagnostic accuracy with and without the AI tool as an auxiliary aid.
